parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism action_type INHIBITOR. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
